main_points: Proposed automation system for converting PDFs to PowerPoint presentations.
Supports large documents and maintains brand control.
User-friendly interface for uploading PDFs and customizing presentations.
important_facts: Output remains editable in PowerPoint, avoiding Google Slides due to font issues.
Default target slide count is ten, adjustable based on content.
Uses n8n for PDF storage and text extraction.
data_points: PDFs are chunked for AI processing if large.
Template library JSON governs slide selection and content fitting.
First slide requires a generated hero image with specific layout.
potential_slide_messages: Maintain brand integrity with automated templates.
Easily review and debug projects with stored logs and outputs.
risks_or_missing_context: Dependence on specific technologies (Next.js, n8n, Google Drive) may limit flexibility.
Potential challenges in accurately summarizing complex PDFs.
Need for clear guidelines on template usage and image generation.
